newsitem.title: ITALY: Deal on Italy telecoms authority distant - ministry.
newsitem.headline: Deal on Italy telecoms authority distant - ministry.

text.p: Agreement among Italian political parties on a draft law to establish a watchdog authority for the telecommunications sector remains some way off, posts ministry undersecretary Michele Lauria said on Tuesday.
Creation by parliament of the authority, whose responsibilities will include television, is a vital step before the Treasury can privatise telecoms group Stet.

"Further steps forward have been made in a constructive climate but we are still pretty far from a precise agreement," Lauria told reporters after a meeting of a Senate (upper house) sub-committee examining draft ministry proposals.
